notes: Tabata (and EMOM) intervals over 60 s shown as m:ss
Sound prompt on athlete phones (joining from an invite link) is a button below the clock instead of covering it; any touch on the clock turns the sound on
Athlete phones: red "no connection" tag when the coach has not been heard for 12 s, and an automatic rejoin; on returning to the app the phone says hello / the coach republishes
